title: 14章：难以割舍的血脉
content_zh:
经历了劫道之后，张父张母的睡意也是消散许多，而张荼只是静默的擦拭着手上的血迹，将长枪还给了边关月后，搬开路障，一行四人再次起航。

    车内的气息有着些许的压抑，阳光透过树木枝丫的缝隙洒落下来，斑斑点点的照进了车中，光明，让张荼不禁为之眯眼。

    这个世道，真的是他想要的么？

    边关月喟叹一声后，说道：“你要知道，如我们这般的，绝对不在少数，每个人都有牵挂，而第一时间奔赴回家的也绝不少数，你若是不除恶务尽，只会导致更多的人……”

    张荼轻轻拍拍方向盘，说道：“你说的我都知道，那些人……该死！我只是在想，仅仅一夜的变化，为什么有的人便会如此？当真是人性本恶么？”

    “人之初，本就没有善恶，但是每个人都是阴阳两面，一如天地一般。当世间定义出善恶之后，也为人的两面打上了标签，一如你，也是如此……”边关月促狭的说道：“你心里也不是有许多不为人知的黑暗小乐趣么？”

    “喂喂喂！”张荼再次拍了拍方向盘，说道：“哪能一样么？我那就是一些恶作剧，他们呢？他们做的那叫做人事儿么？”

    边关月眯眼看着刚刚探出头的太阳，以及道路旁的郁郁葱葱，满是沧桑的说道：“对啊，你哪怕是恶作剧，也会在内心的道德和规范的约束下进行，而如今，可不就是秩序崩碎的开始，当人内心的魔鬼失去了枷锁，究竟会做出什么，谁也无法预料。”

    “你有没有注意他们的眼神？”

    张荼声音带着些许疑惑：“眼神？”

    “对啊，眼神，他们的眼睛里，看不到希望的。”边关月声音出奇的冷清和抽离，就不似人间客一般：“他们眼睛中透露着迷茫、惶恐和绝望。”

    他们或许原本也是老实巴交的汉子，有的人哪怕有些小聪明，也会在秩序和道德的约束下，畏畏缩缩，可是如今，一切丧失监管之后，他们当真还能束缚住内心的猛虎么？

    不是所有人都有着优秀的自控力和向善之心，没有纯粹的好与恶，罪大恶极的凶徒也会有着温柔的一面，而温文儒雅的君子也有着难以示人的一面。

    边关月看着眉头蹙起的张荼，心中不禁莞尔，别看他有时候老谋深算，又是腹黑又是怎么，可是骨子里啊，还是一个有点单纯的孩子。

    不过是在这物欲横流的世界中，慢慢学会了一些自保的手段罢了。

    只是这种人，又好像很难适应这个社会，毕竟你无法做到锐意进取，就已经意味着失败，意味着你在退步，原本的时代，或许真的不适合他把。

    可同时这种人，你又会很放心。

    你永远不用担心，他会无缘无故的背叛你。

    一路无言，每个人都在思忖着下一步该如何行动，而随着越来越熟悉的一草一木，张荼知道，他们的目的地快到了。

    “刺啦！”

    原本放飞自我的钢铁猛兽，再一次猛然停住身形，不过这一次，张荼却是径直向着边关月伸手，说了句：“拿来。”

    边关月嘴角微微的抽搐了一下，张荼沛然的杀意，他自是可以感受，可是他一时间有些担心，太多的杀戮会不会不好。
content_en:
After experiencing the calamity, Zhang's father and Zhang's mother's sleepiness also dissipated a lot, and Zhang Tu just silently wiped the blood on his hands, returned the spear to Bian Guanyue, removed the roadblock, and the four of them set sail again.

    The atmosphere inside the car was a little depressing. The sun was shining through the gaps in the branches of the trees, and it shone into the car in spots. The brightness made Zhang Tu couldn't help but squint.

    Is this world really what he wants?

    Bian Guanyue sighed and said: "You have to know that there are definitely not a few people like us. Everyone is concerned, and there are also many people who rush home as soon as possible. If you don't get rid of the evil, it will only lead to more people..."

    Zhang Tu patted the steering wheel lightly and said: "I know everything you said, those people... damn it! I'm just thinking, why do some people behave like this after just one night's change? Is human nature really evil?"

    "There is no good or evil in the beginning of man, but everyone has two sides of yin and yang, just like heaven and earth. When the world defines good and evil, it also labels the two sides of man, just like you..." Bian Guanyue said narrowly: "Don't you have many unknown dark little pleasures in your heart?"

    "Hey, hey, hey!" Zhang Tu patted the steering wheel again and said, "How can it be the same? What I did was just some pranks, what about them? Is what they did called human affairs?"

    Bian Guanyue squinted at the sun that had just peeked out and the lush greenery beside the road, and said with vicissitudes of life: "Yes, even if you are playing a prank, you will do it under the constraints of your inner morals and norms. But now, this is not the beginning of the collapse of order. When the devil in a person's heart loses its shackles, no one can predict what it will do."

    "Did you notice the look in their eyes?"

    Zhang Tu's voice was a little confused: "Eye?"

    "Yes, there is no hope in their eyes." Bian Guanyue's voice was surprisingly cold and distant, not like a human being: "Their eyes revealed confusion, fear and despair."

    They may have been honest men originally, and some of them, even if they were a little smart, would shrink under the constraints of order and morality. But now, after all supervision is lost, can they really restrain the tiger in their hearts?

    Not everyone has excellent self-control and a heart for good. There is no pure good and evil. The most evil criminals will also have a gentle side, and the gentle and elegant gentlemen will also have a side that is difficult to show.

    Bian Guanyue looked at Zhang Tu, who frowned, and couldn't help but smile in her heart. Even though he was sometimes scheming and scheming, he was still a somewhat innocent child at heart.

    It's just that in this materialistic world, I slowly learned some means of self-protection.

    It's just that it seems difficult for this kind of person to adapt to this society. After all, if you can't forge ahead, it already means failure, which means you are regressing. The original era may not be suitable for him.

    But at the same time, you will feel at ease with this kind of person.

    You never have to worry that he will betray you for no reason.

    There was silence all the way, everyone was thinking about what to do next, and as the plants and trees became more and more familiar, Zhang Tu knew that their destination was approaching.

    "Stab it!"

    The steel beast that had let itself go suddenly stopped again, but this time, Zhang Tu stretched out his hand directly towards Bian Guanyue and said, "Bring it here."

    The corner of Bian Guanyue's mouth twitched slightly. He could certainly feel Zhang Tu Peiran's murderous intention, but he was worried for a moment that too many killings would be bad.
title_en: Chapter 14: The bloodline that is hard to break away from
